pages.title: A String Remembers
pages.text: Make a deliberate irreversible improvement to a found bow.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Bows, upgrades and etchings appear in chests at differing rates. Read the Alt tooltip first: string/frame upgrades are irreversible. Use a real obtained bow, not an empty placeholder.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Find bows, frames, strings and etchings in location-dependent chest loot. Anvil upgrades are irreversible.
